// Fixture-only bridge exercises the actual component mutations without a provider.
import { v as fixtureV } from "convex/values";
import * as fixtureHelpers from "../../lib/oauth/dbHelpers.ts";
export const fixtureBridge = mutation({
  args: { stateHash: fixtureV.string(), ticketCodeHash: fixtureV.string() },
  returns: fixtureV.union(fixtureV.null(), fixtureV.number()),
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const claimed = await fixtureHelpers.claimAuthorizationRequest<Doc<"authorizationRequests">>(ctx, args.stateHash);
    if (!claimed || claimed.expired) return null;
    await fixtureHelpers.insertTicket<Doc<"tickets">>(ctx, { stateHash: args.stateHash, ticketCodeHash: args.ticketCodeHash, encryptedPayload: "fixture", ...(claimed.doc.authorizationStartedAt === undefined ? {} : { authorizationStartedAt: claimed.doc.authorizationStartedAt }) });
    return claimed.doc.authorizationStartedAt ?? null;
  },
});
export const fixtureMint = mutation({args:{stateHash:fixtureV.string(),ticketCodeHash:fixtureV.string(),encryptedPayload:fixtureV.string(),legacy:fixtureV.boolean()},returns:fixtureV.null(),handler:async(ctx,args)=>{const r=await fixtureHelpers.claimAuthorizationRequest<Doc<"authorizationRequests">>(ctx,args.stateHash);if(!r||r.expired)throw new Error("missing authorization"); await fixtureHelpers.insertTicket<Doc<"tickets">>(ctx,{stateHash:args.stateHash,ticketCodeHash:args.ticketCodeHash,encryptedPayload:args.encryptedPayload,...(!args.legacy && r.doc.authorizationStartedAt!==undefined?{authorizationStartedAt:r.doc.authorizationStartedAt}:{})});return null;}});
